verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships a hosted platform (Pipecat Cloud) and a CLI with a `cloud` deploy command, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents API keys, token scopes, or permission controls for agents, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
